caption_lead: Table 1: The three frozen strata and their improvement media.
caption_tail: Line counts are Rust only (whitespace excluded), measured on 2026-11-07 against agent-kernel@47b93dc, react-agent@cc9d785 and rsi-agent@679f5d3. The kernel core alone is 515 lines across 10 files, so the ratio of kernel lines to resident lines is 1:25. The frozen surface of the stack is thus one twenty-fifth the size of the code it governs.
